legal.title: Legal notice
legal.s1Body: Eclipse Auto is an educational project built as part of the French Développeur Web et Web Mobile (DWWM) professional qualification. It is a fictional online car dealership application. No real commercial transaction takes place on this site.
legal.s4Body: The images used on this site come from Unsplash and are subject to their respective licences. The project source code is available on GitHub for educational purposes.
legal.s5Body: The data collected (first name, last name, email) is used solely for the purposes of demonstrating this project. It is stored securely with Supabase and is never shared with third parties. Under the GDPR, you may request the deletion of your data at any time by contacting the publisher.
legal.s6Body: This site uses session cookies only, to handle user authentication. No advertising or tracking cookies are used.
legal.s7Body: Eclipse Auto is a fictional, educational project. The vehicles shown, the prices displayed and the contact details do not correspond to any real business. No purchase, payment or transaction is possible on this site.
